Apply or clear one face-beauty category, or apply one preset package.
Pass exactly one of
--skin/--shape/--feature/--makeup/--body/--makeup-root/--preset. Category
options accept on/off/clear; --preset accepts a resource URI. Use --item for
semantic item keys resolved by videoeditor during patch apply.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --seg-id <SEG_ID[,SEG_ID...]> ... 
                              Target segment id; repeat --seg-id or pass a comma-separated list
          --seg-type <TYPE[,TYPE...]> 
                              Target segment type; must match this typed shortcut
          --target-track <INDEX[,INDEX...]> 
                              Target track index(es)
          --seg-index <INDEX[,INDEX...]> 
                              Comma-separated segment indexes within one target track, e.g.
                              0,2,-1
          --time-window <START,END> 
                              Select segments overlapping the half-open timeline window
                              [start,end); start must be less than end
          --skin TEXT         Skin management: on/off/clear
          --shape TEXT        Face shape: on/off/clear
          --feature TEXT      Facial features: on/off/clear
          --makeup TEXT       Makeup: on/off/clear
          --body TEXT         Body shaping: on/off/clear
          --makeup-root TEXT  Makeup root anchor: on/off/clear
          --preset TEXT       One-tap preset resource URI: vimo://<id> / local://<path>
          --resource TEXT     Figure resource URI: vimo://<id> / local://<path>
          --item TEXT         Portable semantic item key in skin/shape/feature, such as
                              skin.whiten, shape.slim_face, or feature.nose_height; see the
                              atomic Skill for the complete portable list. Only valid with
                              category=on and an absolute --amount
          --amount TEXT       Resource-specific finite adjustment amount; bare values,
                              percentages, signed values, and relative updates are allowed.
                              Resource-specific scalar; bare finite values and percentages are
                              accepted.
          --skin-tone-warmth TEXT 
                              Skin tone warmth slider; negative values are cooler, positive
                              values are warmer. Resource-specific scalar; bare finite values
                              and percentages are accepted.
          --preset-intensity TEXT 
                              Preset intensity with normalized scalar or percent. Use a bare
                              scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0,1].
          --face-mode TEXT    Face mode: multi / single
          --face-id TEXT      Face id (required when --face-mode single)
          --subject-ref TEXT  Versioned person reference returned by material-understand; use
                              instead of --face-id
          --makeup-root-resource TEXT 
                              Makeup root resource (optional, only with --makeup on)
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

NOTE: face-beauty only applies to video segments; pass one category per command.
      Standalone --preset execution expands auto_beauty.json into real figures
      and persists one-tap preset metadata.
EXAMPLES
  # Enable skin management with a resource, amount and multi-face mode
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --skin on --resource vimo://<id> --amount 0.8 --face-mode multi
  # Enable a semantic item; videoeditor resolves it to the matching resource URI
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --shape on --item shape.slim_face --amount 0.5 --face-mode multi
  # Apply a skin tone item with intensity and warmth sliders
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --skin on --resource vimo://<id> --amount 0.65 --skin-tone-warmth -0.15 --face-mode multi
  # Turn off the makeup category
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --makeup off
  # Set the standalone makeup-root anchor (no --amount is required)
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --makeup-root on --resource vimo://<id> --face-mode multi
  # Apply a one-tap preset package
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --preset vimo://<id> --preset-intensity 80% --face-mode multi
  # Apply one item to a person returned by material-understand
  $ lyra-cli draft video face-beauty --seg-id <UUID> --shape on --resource vimo://<id> --amount 0.5 --face-mode single --subject-ref mu://<analysis_id>/subject/<subject_id>
